metadata.timing_methodology: Solver instances are reused across scrambles within a batch. Thistlethwaite and Kociemba still lazy-load heavy tables inside their first timed solve call, so one-off initialization cost is amortized but not strictly excluded from solve_time_seconds.
metadata.scramble_depth_semantics: scramble_depth records the requested scramble length; verified_scramble_depth is populated only when the exact distance is known from the optimal Korf backend.
metadata.scramble_corpus_status: Legacy canonical thesis corpus generated before no-consecutive-same-face scramble generation was added. Scramble depth fields are requested lengths; some sequences contain adjacent same-face moves and cancellations.

external_exact_backend_provenance.note: Installed PyPI distribution metadata does not expose an upstream commit or formal license field.
